body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL
Part of #27377 (wave 3, W3-C3b)

QA run record for the 18.3.0 release-candidate sweep, card W3-C3b: the manual set on the `browser` and `mixed` surfaces, 55 items. Every clause was driven live in a real browser (Playwright chromium) plus its API half, against the Console built in-repo. Item-level verdicts are derived from the clause verdicts, never hand-assigned. Run under `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`.

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: `c4c515ad3cc342043a2b81b5a06a5793f79a23e8`, detached and pinned; it never followed main. `ui/` is the same commit, and the Console was built from it with `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (114/114 tasks, exit 0). The CLI reports 18.2.0 (workspace version, pre-Version-PR).
- Boot (per runner): a scratch copy of `examples/app-showcase` under `/tmp/qa-w3c3b/RUNNER/app`, with `node_modules` symlinked to the tree. Command: `OS_PORT=PORT OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=RUN/uploads OS_HOME=RUN/home setsid node packages/cli/bin/run.js dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:RUN/data.db`.
- Ports: 41101–41112 (one per runner), plus a local webhook receiver on 41116 and a fake SMTP capture on 41125. Every runner had its own file DB and browser context.
- Extra boots, each on the runner's own port and DB:
  - group-posture walled boots (`OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`) for approvals.decision-action-matrix A9 and records-forms.record-discussion-mentions A9;
  - `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1` for integration-system.job-scheduled-run;
  - a zero-user `OS_DISABLE_SIGNUP=true --no-seed-admin` boot for identity-auth.first-run-owner-bootstrap;
  - env-lock reboots (`OS_LOCALIZATION_TIMEZONE`, `OS_MAIL_SMTP_PASSWORD`) for platform-core.settings-hub-roundtrip;
  - a minimal `examples/app-todo` boot (no messaging) for integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery A3.
- Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai), the stock showcase seed (`com.example.showcase 132 rows`), and the demo personas. Members were minted per RUNNER, by invite then sign-up or by admin create-user. Each persona's identity was proved with `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` before its cells.
- Timestamps: environment prep started 2026-10-29T04:21Z, the build was green at 04:34Z, and the runs ended at 06:56Z.
- Execution: 12 runner subagents, at most 3 browser runners at a time, in staggered waves. The orchestrator spot-checked each verdict against its runner's transcript (decisive response strings) and checked every FAIL against source.
- Hygiene: after the run, `git status` is clean, `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack` does not exist, and no listener remains on any run port. The cli.scaffold leg's newcomer boot wrote `/root/.objectstack/dev-crypto-key` outside the repo; that is the default with no OS_HOME.
- Time: environment prep about 91 min (13 min install and build, 3 min canary, 75 min of runner boots and fixtures) against about 398 min of testing plus 76 min of off-clause probes, summed across runners. Prep to testing is about 1 : 4.4 (1 : 5.2 with probes).

## Scope

Selector `release-18.3.0-w3-manual-browser`: the manual browser/mixed set of anchor #27377 §0, card W3-C3b. There are no planned items in the set. Each item's revision comes from `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs ID --json` at the subject:

Clause ids: `A#` is `acceptance[#]` and `N#` is `negative[#]`, both zero-based. Negatives that are only a scope or cross-reference note (no oracle) are scored pass as "note honoured": nothing was scored outside the item's stated scope. That reading is parked on the anchor as an accuracy finding.

## Derived item verdicts

44 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 8 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 1 NOT-RUN (54 of 55 judged).

- FAIL (8): api-backend.formula-stdlib-matrix, studio-authoring.expression-editors, studio-authoring.access-owd-and-suggestions, studio-authoring.app-and-nav-properties, studio-authoring.authored-page-slots-and-variables, studio-authoring.dashboard-widget-and-filter-types, studio-authoring.summary-field-authoring, studio-authoring.held-edit-leave-guard
- PARTIAL (2): automation.setup-packaged-automation-board (A5 blocked fixture), integration-system.webhook-lifecycle (A2 blocked dependency #23166, A4 blocked fixture)
- NOT-RUN (1): studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix (handover below)
- PASS (44): every other item.

- A1 pass: the held action answers 200 for a showcase_ops holder and 403 for a non-holder ("requires capability [showcase.export_data]"). Clone withdraw → 403, restore → 200. The missing/and/empty cross-checks hold.
- A2 pass: a scratch copy shadowing manage_platform_settings is refused at boot ("Security catalog name conflict", exit 1); the runtime PUT → 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE.
- A3 pass: scope 'galaxy' fails `os validate` with exit 1 (`capabilities.2.scope: Invalid value 'galaxy'`); runtime create → 403 NOT_CREATABLE.
- N0 pass: no runtime capability write answered 2xx.

Boundary classes tried: empty string, missing id, unknown id, whitespace, wrong type, non-JSON body, inverted window, out-of-range limit, opposite posture (member on admin doors, draft vs active, walled vs single), and readers outside the asserted scope (third members, anonymous, cross-org).
